compos.text: A red rectangular button with the text "Try Again" in white.
Text message on a red background stating, "There were no close matches."
The image shows a red banner with white text that reads "ALIVE ONESCAN PRO."
Bullet point with text: "Make sure lighting conditions are sufficient."
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."
Bullet point instruction: "Focus on the image so that it fills the camera."

Alt text: "Smartphone status bar displaying various icons from left to right: multiple Facebook notification icons, Wi-Fi signal, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, battery charging, lock, alarm, calendar, email, and battery level indicator. The time displayed is 1:32."
Alt text: "Instruction text: Hold your phone still and scan."
The image shows the text "Most Viewed Videos."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "ALIVE ONESCAN PRO." The main content of the screen indicates that no close matches were found during a scan. It provides instructions to improve the scanning process:

1. Focus on the image so that it fills the camera screen.
2. Hold your phone still and scan.
3. Ensure lighting conditions are sufficient.

There is a prominent "Try Again" button for the user to attempt the scan again. Below this, there is a section titled "Most Viewed Videos," displaying a horizontal list of video thumbnails with brief titles.
